name: reading-level-tinter
title: Reading Level Tinter
description: Each sentence is tinted by its own complexity — average word length and clause count map to an ink density ramp — so a paragraph shows you where it gets hard to read before you get there.
designRules:
# Design System

Genre: Technical
Macrostructure: Stack
Density: Medium
Shape: Sharp
Motion: None
Typography: Humanist
Color: Monochrome

## Rules

- Static: the interaction model is part of the design, not an add-on.
- Reduced motion replaces animation with a state change; nothing is hidden behind motion.
- The component composes through `cn` and never hardcodes colours.

## Avoid

- Reskinning this resource and republishing it under a new name.
- Adding shadows or radii that contradict its shape language.
